description: Header file defining structures and functions for a stat cache system in the lighttpd web server, including cache management, entry handling, and asynchronous stat operations.

classes.name: liStatCache
classes.description: Structure representing the stat cache, managing cache entries, directories, and statistics.

classes.name: liStatCacheEntry
classes.description: Structure representing individual cache entries, including file or directory info, state, and associated requests.

classes.name: liStatCacheEntryData
classes.description: Structure holding detailed data for a cache entry, such as path, etag, content type, and stat info.

methods.name: li_stat_cache_new
methods.description: Creates a new stat cache instance with specified TTL.

methods.name: li_stat_cache_free
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with a stat cache.

methods.name: li_stat_cache_get
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cache entry for a given path, performing stat if needed.

methods.name: li_stat_cache_get_sync
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves a cache entry for a given path, blocking until completion.

methods.name: li_stat_cache_get_dirlist
methods.description: Retrieves directory listing info for a given path.

methods.name: li_stat_cache_entry_acquire
methods.description: Increments reference count for a cache entry.

methods.name: li_stat_cache_entry_release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for a cache entry, allowing cleanup.
